title: should create a SQL multi alert end-to-end and pin the payload
verifies: the Multi flow saves a SQL multi alert and pins function=count, group_by=[], threshold>=1

title: should swap the Simple "No. of events" row for the "Alert if [column]" row when Multi is chosen
verifies: the Simple/Multi toggle swaps the SQL condition row deterministically

title: should show the Multi toggle selected and the stored column when editing a SQL multi alert
verifies: edit mode hydrates the Multi radio and pre-populated value column

title: should save a Simple SQL count alert with aggregation dropped to null
verifies: Simple SQL count parity drops aggregation on save

title: should block save with a required-column error when Multi has no value column
verifies: Multi + empty value column blocks save and shows the inline error

title: should show the HAVING-clause warning banner when the user SQL carries its own HAVING
verifies: a query with its own HAVING shows the warning banner

title: should clear the chosen column when the query edit drops that projection
verifies: editing the query to drop a projection clears the stale column selection
